hooks.name: Block secrets in agent writes
hooks.description: Blocks any agent file write whose content looks like an LLM API key, so keys stay in a gitignored .env.local written by a human.

action.command: if grep -Eq '(fw_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|sk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|(^|[^A-Za-z0-9-])sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}|DIT_LLM_API_KEY=[^"[:space:]\\]+)'; then echo 'Blocked: this write looks like it contains an API key. Put keys in .env.local yourself; never in code, specs or docs.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
